explanation: The excerpt omits the title. Its database clause requires the database to be licensed under the same license, which is a ShareAlike condition, and sibling files in the same repository are CC BY-SA 4.0. Refused as CC-BY-SA-4.0, but the title is not visible in the excerpt.
